entity.name: DXB Vertiport
entity.meta_description: DXB Vertiport (registered VDX) received UAE GCAA certification on 7 July 2026 — the world's first purpose-built commercial vertiport, developed by Skyports Infrastructure at Dubai International Airport. Certified for eVTOL operations; Joby Aviation passenger service pending launch.
